messages.subject: Opportunity in Brazil for Carpentries Instructors and Bioconductor Presenters!
messages.subject_clean: Opportunity in Brazil for Carpentries Instructors and Bioconductor Presenters!
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

We’re seeking a Carpentries-certified instructor to represent Bioconductor at the 2025 Brazilian Genetics Society Meeting in Belém do Pará, Brazil. Help co-teach a Bioconductor workshop and potentially present a symposia or roundtable to raise awareness of Bioconductor in the Latin American bioinformatics and genetics communities.
Carpentries certification required for co-teaching the workshop
August 13-16, 2025 (pending proposal approval)
Travel & accommodation covered for the workshop instructor (grant funding or employer support also encouraged)

Interested in solely presenting a symposia or roundtable on Bioconductor? You’re welcome to apply! Travel support is prioritized for the workshop instructor, but the conference covers food and accommodation for presenters.

Interested? Complete the  expression of interest form <https://forms.gle/FQcVNjbVnGe9Yk497> by Oct 26, 2024!

Maria Doyle, PhD

Bioconductor Community Manager

School of Medicine,

University of Limerick, Limerick, V94 T9PX
Ireland

Email: maria...@ul.ie
Phone (office): +353 61 234 768

Connect with the Bioconductor community at our conferences:
BioCAsia 2024 (November 7-8, Sydney, Australia) <https://biocasia2024.bioconductor.org/>
GBCC 2025 (June 23-26, New York, USA) <https://www.linkedin.com/posts/bioconductor_gbcc2025-bioconductor-galaxy-activity-7236739126190829569-QdEH>
EuroBioC 2025 (September 17-19, Barcelona, Spain) <https://www.linkedin.com/posts/bioconductor_eurobioc2024-eurobioc2025-activity-7237888796564885505-hUW6>

I work flexible hours across several time zones. I don't expect you to read or respond to my emails outside of your normal working hours.
